title: Battery drain issue
symptom: After switching from a Samsung A71 to a Pixel 10, AndroidAPS background processes drain 45-50% of battery, causing the phone to last only about 9 hours on a full charge with minimal use. The phone also runs constantly warm.
cause: The thread does not definitively identify a root cause. The user speculates it might be a stuck process from the initial OS update, but this is not confirmed.
fix: The issue resolved itself after the phone completely discharged and was recharged, which apparently cleared a stuck process. No specific action was taken by the user to fix it.
evidence_quote: So whatever was causing the drainage, must've been some stuck proccess that was there from when I first set up the phone. And the complete drain that happened today did some hard reset or something.
